title: create_region result
description: What create_region returns: the new region, with the GUID that addresses it and the index REAPER assigned. The start and end come back because the region is now what turns a request framed by section into a time span — its GUID bounds a render, and its start and end go into set_time_selection. The end is always greater than the start, since the extension refuses to write a region that is not (Requirement 9.6). A mutating tool, so it carries the undo report fields defined by messages/tool-result-undo.schema.json.

regionDetail.description: A project region. Its start and end are what turn a request framed by section — "render the chorus" — into a time span, so both are always reported.

index.description: Region index as assigned by REAPER.

end.description: Region end position in seconds. Always greater than start — the extension refuses to write a region that is not (Requirement 9.6).

guid.description: A stable REAPER GUID, in REAPER's own braced form.

timelinePosition.description: A position on the project timeline, in seconds from the start.

color.description: Colour as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB string prefixed with #.

undoPositionBefore.description: REAPER undo stack position captured by the extension immediately before this tool applied its change. A "revert all AI changes" operation calls Undo_DoUndo2 in a loop until the stack is back at this position.

undoDescription.description: Undo point description the extension passed to Undo_EndBlock2 for this tool, persisted with the tool_result message so the chat UI can list what the agent changed.
